# Positive Therapy FL

Positive Therapy FL is a premier mental health provider based in South Florida, offering holistic, mind-body wellness through online and in-person therapy.

## Core Services
- Counseling for individuals, couples, and new mothers.
- Specialized support for stress, anxiety, relationship issues, and major life changes.
- Integrative health services: Lab-informed care, medication-supported weight loss, nutritional counseling, and health coaching.
